content_sections.heading: NBT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 142/2026/Estt. gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NBT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree (B. Deg.) in Exhibition Design from a recognised University; 10 years' experience Experience: 10 years Age limit: Maximum 45 years Other conditions: Initial engagement is for three months, extendable as per requirement. No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending the interview. Desirable: Master's degree in relevant field would be preferred Minimum 10 years' relevant experience in publicity branding, event promotion and conceptualisation and execution of promotional material for events and exhibition Understanding of Tier-1 and Tier-2 cities landscape Experience in independently managing and coordinating Government events, exhibitions, fairs and other large-scale events in reputed Government organisations, PSUs or reputed institutions

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NBT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates whose applications are incomplete - incomplete applications will be rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis through Placement Agency Initially for three months Extendable as per requirement of the Trust

content_sections.heading: How Will NBT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Walk-in interview between 11:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m. on 18-11-2026 Originals must be produced at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form with self-attested passport size photograph Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, degrees, testimonials Mark sheet, age certificate, experience certificate, caste certificate (self-attested) Originals of certificates for production at the interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from www.nbtindia.gov.in. Fill in the form and paste a self-attested passport size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, degrees and testimonials. Appear at National Book Trust, India on 18-11-2026 between 11:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m. with the form and originals.

content_sections.text: Candidature cancelled if any information is found false or ineligibility detected at any stage
